q: How do I remove the app or move it to my SD card?

runs: If your device included >x< for Android as a bundled application, it cannot be uninstalled or moved to SD card.
The option to move to SD would only move the application itself (1.89mb), not the data while using the app. If on SD, the app will lose your login information.

q: Can I change the font size on >x< for Android?

runs: Yes, you can adjust the font size displayed on your >x< for Android app through your Android’s device settings. If you update the font size through your device settings and do not see the update right away, try restarting your app. Please note: It is no longer possible to update font size directly through your >x< for Android app.
